vehicles: Nissan Patrol GU V Wagon 3.0 TDI / ZD30CRD

flash_memory_map.full_flash: ~2 MB total (approx 1 MB flash + 2 KB EEPROM for adaptations/immobiliser)
flash_memory_map.calibration_region: Separate working calibration file available in reference

checksum.description: Primary: 7 multipoint CRC32 regions (IEEE 0xEDB88320 poly, init/xor 0xFFFFFFFF) aligned to diesel map blocks. CS treated as final 4 bytes of each region. Correction forces region CRC to 0. Secondary: additive 16-bit sum-to-zero retained. Matches WinOLS EDC16 plugin concept (multipoint + compatibility test CS). Exact poly/block tables still proprietary — verify against WinOLS-corrected bin for production use.
checksum.notes: WinOLS EDC16 plugin features: auto-search, multipoint CRC correction, compatibility-test CS (can patch correction value at map end instead of full recompute), manufacturer keys (Nissan Patrol supported since ~2007), EEPROM block handling. To lock exact match: diff original vs WinOLS-corrected pair and update CRC32_REGIONS / target.

security_access.reference: Code for Device.md + planned edc16_seedkey.rs (similar to security.rs for P01)

maps_and_xdf.description: No ready XDF in reference. Auto tables use refined community-typical addresses for ZD30CRD (Driver Wish ~0x80000, IQ ~0x82000, Boost ~0xC0000, Rail ~0xC2000, VGT ~0xC4000). These are solid starting points; refine with your own bin.
maps_and_xdf.eeprom: EDC16C41 working eeprom (2 KB) - immobiliser, adaptations, coding data

notes: Matches and expands the REFERENCE_INDEX.md entry. 23710-VS43B is the specific hardware/part for GU V Wagon variant. DB entry enables auto-identification. Rust support added: CAN (ELM/ISO-TP), KWP2000, Nissan Consult II for live data + commands. Use protocol selector in UI. **Multipoint CRC32 now primary** for EDC16C41.
